title.zh: DeepSeek或将完成约120亿美元融资，腾讯和宁德时代或参投
title.en: DeepSeek或将完成约120亿美元融资，腾讯和宁德时代或参投

current_state.zh: DeepSeek 据报即将完成第二轮融资，规模约1000亿元人民币，投前估值约5000亿元人民币，新老股东拟投资金额约各占一半，新进投资方以产业投资方为主。
current_state.en: DeepSeek is reportedly set to close its second funding round at roughly ¥100B, with a pre-money valuation of about ¥500B; new and existing shareholders are expected to split the round roughly evenly, with new industrial investors taking part.

updates.title_zh: DeepSeek或将完成约120亿美元融资，腾讯和宁德时代或参投
updates.title_en: DeepSeek或将完成约120亿美元融资，腾讯和宁德时代或参投
updates.what_changed_zh: 据报道，DeepSeek 正在完成一轮至少 800 亿元人民币（约合 120 亿美元）的融资，远高于其此前 500 亿元的目标，腾讯和宁德时代承诺认购其中很大一部分，此前其最新模型发布后需求和投资者兴趣激增。
updates.what_changed_en: DeepSeek is reportedly closing a funding round of at least ¥80B (~$12B), well above its earlier ¥50B target, with Tencent and CATL committing significant portions as demand and investor interest surge following its latest model release.
updates.current_state_zh: 据报道，DeepSeek 正在完成一轮至少 800 亿元人民币（约合 120 亿美元）的融资，远高于其此前 500 亿元的目标，腾讯和宁德时代承诺认购其中很大一部分，此前其最新模型发布后需求和投资者兴趣激增。

updates.what_changed_zh: 融资规模从此前报道的至少800亿元人民币进一步提高至约1000亿元人民币，投前估值仍约5000亿元人民币，新进产业投资方包括石溪资本、中芯聚源、CPE源峰、君联资本、吉利等。
updates.what_changed_en: The funding size increased from the previously reported at least ¥80B to roughly ¥100B, with the pre-money valuation unchanged at about ¥500B and new industrial investors including Shixi Capital, SMIC Capital, CPE, Legend Capital, and Geely.
updates.current_state_zh: DeepSeek 据报即将完成第二轮融资，规模约1000亿元人民币，投前估值约5000亿元人民币，新老股东拟投资金额约各占一半，新进投资方以产业投资方为主。
updates.current_state_en: DeepSeek is reportedly set to close its second funding round at roughly ¥100B, with a pre-money valuation of about ¥500B; new and existing shareholders are expected to split the round roughly evenly, with new industrial investors taking part.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: DeepSeek is set to close its second funding round at roughly 100 billion yuan — double the previously planned 50 billion yuan — at an unchanged pre-money valuation of about 500 billion yuan, with new industrial investors including Shixi Capital, SMIC Capital, CPE, Legend Capital and Geely taking about half of the round.
updates.detailed_summary_en: DeepSeek is set to close its second funding round at roughly 100 billion yuan — double the previously planned 50 billion yuan — at an unchanged pre-money valuation of about 500 billion yuan, with new industrial investors including Shixi Capital, SMIC Capital, CPE, Legend Capital and Geely taking about half of the round.
